Associates one or more backlog items with a priority plan by updating each
backlog item's priority_plan_ref.



Note: Priority plan membership is child-owned on BLI.priority_plan_ref.

This command is a convenience shortcut for 'zqk object ref add <bli_id>
<plan_id>'.

For general reference management across all objects, use 'zqk object ref add'.

  Add backlog item to plan
  zqk.test pplan add [REDACTED-ID] [REDACTED-ID]
  Add multiple backlog items to plan
  zqk.test pplan add [REDACTED-ID] [REDACTED-ID] [REDACTED-ID]
  Alternative positional syntax
  zqk.test pplan [REDACTED-ID] add [REDACTED-ID]

Usage:
  zqk.test object pplan add [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --force                   Force association (alias for override)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
      --override                Override scope-lock on sealed (active/in-progress) priority plans
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --reason-code string      Reason code required when using --override on sealed priority plan
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
